response.guide: Each entry is one disclosed transaction. Always display the source (Tip Ranks) as attribution. transaction_date is when the trade occurred; disclosure_date is when it was made public - this lag can be up to 45 days, so treat entries as historical information, not a real-time signal, and do not imply the information is more recent than it is. Amounts are disclosed ranges - never present them as exact figures. Do not present politician trades as a recommendation or endorsement.
